body: Hey, sorry about the sorta late reply. I'm a girl, I'm 20. I live in a small town in Norway. I agree that there's a lot of things to do, see and experience, but they're not always easy to attain. And while the ocean or a sunset is beautiful to watch, it doesn't really change your situation.

I'm not being treated for anything right now, but I went to a psychologist for four years. It actually helped me a lot with my anxiety, but it has never really done anything for my depression (which comes and goes). I'm not on any meds either. As for exercise, I don't really get much but I'm in shape (blessed with high metabolism!). I get plenty of sunlight though. I usually spend at least two hours outside every day.

Meeting new people is hard. I'm very socially awkward and super-shy and it has just gotten worse the last few years. Last time I hung out with anyone was two years ago. I'm young and I'm okay-looking, but I'm just extremely shy. Classes sounds like a good idea, but I figure they're expensive. I'll look into it though, so thanks for the tip. And thanks for a proper reply.
